features.description: After the fourth retrigger only money and collect symbols land, and each collector pays the money values beside it.

review:
A time-themed game built on oversized symbols. Wilds and premiums can land as normal symbols or as 2x2 blocks carrying a random 1x–12x multiplier, and multipliers in one win add up.

Three to five scatters give 6, 8 or 10 free spins, and every third scatter adds six spins and unlocks the next level – bringing 3x3 symbols and multipliers up to 24x. After the fourth retrigger only money and collect symbols land. 96.5% RTP. For fans of long, building bonuses.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
